scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.start:api: npm run db:setup --workspace apps/api && npm run start --workspace apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
